topArticle.title: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
topArticle.description:
Dozens of Bank of England directors and founding subscribers invested in trafficking of enslaved Africans
The Bank of England and the British financial system were for centuries deeply involved in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people, according to new research on Britain’s slavery history.
Research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders has found that the scale of the financial system’s involvement in enslavement is greater than previously known or acknowledged. The Bank of England, the central bank owned by the government since nationalisation by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration in 1946, had dozens of financiers involved in its foundation who were also significant investors in the transatlantic trafficking of enslaved Africans.

topArticle.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
topArticle.description:
Passionate documentary maker  won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile 
Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol, Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian: “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.”
 Continue reading...

topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、幼い子どもたちが恐怖、日常の崩壊、基本的な栄養の喪失に苦しんでいる。家族は避難所を求める中、彼らの心身への影響は深刻である。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビアの地震で忘れ去られた生存者たち
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋での生活を余儀なくされ、ホームレス、過密な避難所、病気、そして存在を忘れられるという苦境に直面している現状。

topArticle.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
topArticle.description: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.
topArticle.titleJa: メキシコのカルテル多発地域で数千人が暴力の終結を要求
topArticle.summary: シナロア・カルテルの対立する2つの派閥間で抗争が勃発して以来、暴力が急増しているクリアカンで、数千人が暴力の終結を求めてデモを行いました。

topArticle.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
topArticle.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
topArticle.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が強まる中、トランプ氏の対応が鍵に
topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島に関して「変革の風」を約束する中、ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国支配に対する立場を変えるかどうかが注目されています。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権の武器化：ニカラグアにおける反対意見の封じ込め
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアで、権威主義的な政権が市民権を剥奪することで反対意見を封じ込める手法について論じる記事。

topArticle.title: NZ apologises to children forced to live in bush for years with fugitive dad
topArticle.description: A public inquiry has found that agencies "missed key opportunities" to recover the children sooner.
topArticle.titleJa: NZ、逃亡中の父親と数年間森で暮らすことを強いられた子どもたちに謝罪
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランド政府は、逃亡中の父親と長年森で生活を強いられた子どもたちに対し謝罪した。公的調査により、当局が子どもたちを早期に保護する機会を逸したことが判明した。

topArticle.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
topArticle.description: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.
topArticle.titleJa: 中国、AIを巡る「悪意ある競争」との見方を批判
topArticle.summary: 中国は、AI開発における「悪意ある競争」との見方を批判した。これは、Anthropic CEOがAI開発の減速を呼びかけつつ、中国が先行するのを防ぐ形を提唱したことに対する反応だ。

topArticle.title: More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older
topArticle.description: Figures show 88% of the centenarians are women as the population continues to age and shrink.
topArticle.titleJa: 日本で100歳以上の人口が10万人を超える
topArticle.summary: 日本では100歳以上の人口が10万人を超え、その88%が女性であることが判明した。人口の高齢化と減少が進む日本の現状を示すものだ。

topArticle.title: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
topArticle.description: The killing of the 16-year-old nearly a year ago had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about social media.
topArticle.titleJa: マレーシアの少年、精神異常を理由に女子生徒殺害で無罪に
topArticle.summary: 約1年前にマレーシアを震撼させた16歳女子生徒殺害事件で、少年が精神異常を理由に無罪となった。この判決はソーシャルメディアに関する議論を巻き起こしている。

topArticle.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
topArticle.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
topArticle.titleJa: ロシア連邦、特定のフラット鋼製品に関するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
topArticle.summary: ロシア連邦が、ユーラシア経済連合に輸入される特定のフラット鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
topArticle.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の米に関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルが、特定の種類の米の輸入に対してセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。
